svg.title: Writing a physical activity prescription: first check it is safe (absolute contraindications stop it; otherwise stratify cardiovascular risk to decide how to start), then write the dose with F.I.T.T., then tailor it for hypertension and blood pressure medications; adjust if pain or swelling follows

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Prescribe physical activity like a drug: is it SAFE, then what DOSE?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 A's: ASK (activity, aware of benefits?) · ADVISE (benefits) · ACT (signpost to help)

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: ask: current activity · intentions · past activity + preferences, barriers, goals · is it safe (symptoms, history)?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: biggest gain: from NONE to SOME, so target sedentary patients · some is good, more is better

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: LOW FITNESS: independent risk of death, as big as smoking, hypertension, cholesterol · hip fractures ↓ 55% (fewer falls) ·

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: only 25% of physicians counsel · 92% of patients would follow · a prescription raises activity 10%

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: case: 68 F, sedentary, fears falling, new untreated hypertension 140/85 · father MI at 70, mother hip fracture at 73
